description: Selenium drives a browser so a test can use a page much like a person does. We will check tiny pages using Python, clear locators and explicit waits. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.

seo.title: Selenium Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Selenium with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
